methods: Write typed entry/exit contracts and a contracting multitype recurrence.

actual_scope: Exact three-cycle output-frame restoration for fixed cyclic-equivariant readers, with a shortest boundary planner and complete recursively emitted dirty echo.
scope_change_reason: Refine the assigned recursive-interface track to a non-scalar workspace drift. Existing PR1227 covers signs; PR1199/1203/1205 cover invariant or cancelling readers. Here readers may observe changing coordinates but must intertwine fixed order-three permutations.
bottleneck_link: A conditional boundary mechanism removes paid workspace rotations between fixed child calls. This is an interface result, not an identified selected-supplier replacement or a new kappa.
stop_rule: Finish all declared order-three boundary schedules through four children, all 3x3 ternary admission matrices, and bounded recursive maps; reject if the full source-only echo has no priced saving. Begin final verification by 21:54 UTC.
